name: Web Application Exploitation & Web Shell Runbook
containment_steps: Block attacker IP address at WAF or reverse proxy level
Quarantine or delete uploaded malicious script/webshell file immediately
Temporarily set web application into maintenance mode if active compromise suspected
investigation_steps: Inspect web server access and error logs for injection payloads and status codes
Identify which web parameters and URIs were targeted (e.g. SQLi, command injection)
Audit directory permissions in webroot for unauthorized file creation
remediation_steps: Patch vulnerable application code or apply parameterized queries
Restrict upload directory permissions to disable script execution
Rotate database credentials if SQL injection compromise occurred
